notes.title: JAILER IS A TERRORIST BUNDLE IS AVAILABLE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/d8176f1b065523c795ccb9db244a2cad256e57ec.png[/img]

[h1]Jailer is a Terrorist bundle is available now![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23424

We are also happy to announce that we have joined forces with other titles in the Jailer is a Terrorist bundle. 
Our special bundle is available to you at a lower and convenient discount - [b]10% on both of the games![/b]

The bundle includes number awesome and exciting titles:

- Prison Simulator
- Counter Terrorist Agency

[b]Prison Simulator[/b] - Get a taste of Prison Life! Become the Prison Guard and deal with dangerous convicts. Prison management, lots of daily activities. Will you become the best Guard in history? Or maybe you'll turn into the worst scumbag this Prison has ever seen?

[b]Counter Terrorist Agency[/b] - Counter Terrorist Agency lets you fight international terrorism and prevent attacks all over the world. Use modern invigilation techniques, discover connections, interrogate suspects, eliminate threats and dismantle terrorist networks.

notes.title: Cyber Ops - RELEASED
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Operators! [/h1]

[h2]We are more than happy to announce that [b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/863460/Cyber_Ops/]Cyber Ops is out now[/url].[/b] [/h2]

Now with loyalty discount for owners of COUNTER TERRORIST AGENCY!

For the last two years, we have been making this game with hard work and a big passion. Cyber Ops offers an immersive world with memorable characters and a fresh challenge for you to enjoy. All of this was made especially for you, so you can join the Geist Division and live this new experience.

[previewyoutube=XBHGnY8ZDXQ;full]<video>[/previewyoutube]

Become a part of the Geist Division, a secret high-tech unit created by the government to protect the country from all kinds of next-gen threats. You are the eye in the sky, the invisible hand, the cyber ghost, looking after your team over the net.

Features
[list]
[*]More than 6 hours of story missions full of cyberpunk themes, investigation and political intrigue.
[*]Real-time audio feedback from squad leaders brings life to the world of Cyber Ops.
[*]Different hacking mechanics to keep control of doors, security devices and cyberlink-equipped brains.
[*]Squad management: recruit new blood for the infiltration squads.
[*]Research and Development: develop new cyber-implants to improve the agents performance.
[*]Retro-futuristic computer interfaces and dark analog synth-based music inspired by 80's cult movies.
[/list]



Hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.content:
Hey Agents!

It's been a while since the last update. We are working hard on the new content. But in the meantime, we want to give you the Update 1.0.6.

Chane log:
- first "case file" update - case file with bookmarks
- new music added
- the ON/OFF background music option (settings in main menu)
- other bug fixes and improvements

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
Hey Agents!

In the last announcement, we've asked you the question. It seems you've made the choice - open mode is the thing you'd like to get in the first place. So now, we are working on two bigger things - new case file and open mode. But in the meantime, we keep fixing and improving. 
Today we are giving you the update with:
- small bugfixes
- one additional scenario.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: New update
notes.content:
Hey Agents!

The work on the case file rearrangement is on. In the meantime, we fixed some bugs and made some improvements:

* pause/resume with [space] key
* fixed wrong locations on the map
* fixed icons in flights
* fixed wrong news after the arrest of the leader
* now the first future event lasts a bit longer
* resources can be removed after police arrest, special units, drone actions or interrogation only
* messages from agents are properly queued
* minor changes in Chinese translation
* fixed - "dead" suspects don't have the "dead-icon" (in summary window)
* fixed - problem with "arrested-icon" in Suspect Details window.

Oh...and by the way - later today, we will ask you one question. But that will be in a separate announcement. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 - more scenarios
notes.content:
Hey Agents.
As promised, after working dozen of hours, we give you a major update 1.0.3 with unblocked 10 scenarios. What is more, from now on you can continue your game after the final scenario. You can exp your agency to maximum, you can try to perfect your earlier analysis, unlock all the achievements etc. 

Mac users – now you have exactly the same game as Windows users. So there is a time management, unblocked scenarios and every bug fix done before. We know there were complaints about crashing on older macOS (e.g. on High Sierra) – now it works just fine.
We hope this update will let you enjoy the game as it should from the beginning. Hopefully some of you, will give CTA second chance and maybe it will be worth of your positive review now.

PATCH 1.03
- 10 scenarios previously unavailable due to bug
- you can continue game after final scenario (to exp to max if you like)
- fixes in flights
- fixes in summary panel
- translation fixes
- Mac fix – now it works also on older macOS versions, time management option and all of the previous improvements added 

Play2Chill Team

notes.title: Windows Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
WINDOWS PATCH 1.02
* pause time/resume time buttons
* slightly slower pace of the game
* lobbying, diplomacy and PR actions take less time to finish
* more meaningful information in resource bonus popup
* resource pop-up message clarification
* minor translation fixes

We listen to requests and suggestions of CTA community. We do our best to react as fast as we can. Today we want to give you the time management funcionality, now you will be able to stop the time, take a breath and think all of these suspects, calls, text etc.We have also slightly slowed down the pace of the game. Another important change is the time needed for lobbying, diplomacy and PR actions. Now all of these actions take less time. It can be crucial when you are planning another step and you need resources in a particular country.
Another thing. Some of you wrote us that they can’t close the resources pop-up window. The main thing is that it can’t be closed before you spend all of the granted points for additional resources. Now the message you get in the pop-up is more obvious. 

We are still waiting for you suggestions and bug reports. Be assured, we won’t rest till you’ll be fully satisfied with CTA.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hey Agents!

First update with patch 1.0.1 is now available.

PATCH 1.0.1
* fixed problems with screen aspect ratio 4:3, properly displayed upgrade screen and casefile
* fixed tiny letters problem in Chinese version
* fixed doubled travel in a scenario
* fixed problem with no summary reward for some groups
* fixed missing translations for Chinese, French, German and Spanish
* fixed: crash when clicked on portrait in analysis panel
* fixed: can't open Connection graph when clicked on portrait (suspect killed or arrested)

Currently we are working on highly anticipated time management option. Stay tuned!
